usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and KIXIE receives outreach through “Send a Team SMS” and “Send to Queue”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send a Team SMS” in KIXIE
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left a checkout gets a team text from your inbox number, through your KIXIE account.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Send a Team SMS” in KIXIE goes out after a scheduled check.
